---
name: Control pack
about: Propose a new control pack or improve an existing pack
title: "[Control Pack]: "
labels: "rule-pack"
assignees: ""
---

## Control Objective

Describe the accounting, inventory, ERP, WIP, work-order, or audit risk this pack should address.

## Source Files

List the ReconForge canonical files required by the controls.

## Example Rules

Describe the rules in plain English before proposing YAML.

## Expected Exceptions

What exceptions should users expect when the control fails?

## Evidence Fields

Which source fields should be copied into evidence outputs?

## Sanitized Sample

Attach only anonymized or synthetic samples. Do not attach live ERP data.

## Acceptance Criteria

How should maintainers validate this pack?

## Claim Boundaries

Do not describe the pack as audit-certified, compliance-certified, customer-proven, or production-validated.
